card.name: Modal verbs before health effects
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as may, can, also, have, cause or chance, right after a subject and just before the health effect or result is stated in patient-information text.

modes.label: Modal verb after a risk subject
modes.description: May or can follows a condition, action or drug and leads into a possible effect.
modes.example: Stopping tranylcypromine sulfate tablets suddenly<< may>> cause withdrawal symptoms.

modes.label: Other linking words before a result
modes.description: Words like chance, also, have, caused or about sit just before the outcome or detail.
modes.example: People who have thyroid problems (hyperthyroidism) may have a higher<< chance>> of having a hypertensive crisis.

card.plain: It fires on small words like "may" or "can" that come just before the text says what a condition or medicine might cause.
